status: STATUS: DESIGN-ONLY, 2026-11-16. Not read by the deployed Worker (nothing imports src/propimages.js yet). Owner decisions 2026-11-16: the Worker knows image A and image B from this file, with the applications on them; the Worker and CI run is STRICT (everything listed for the leg must run, zero skips); gate lane and discovery lane; a release rents two dies per family and the images are split across the two boxes (slot 1 runs image A, slot 2 runs image B; `swap` exchanges them; a family with one die gets both); images are for the release run only. Design: docs/design/V3_WORKER_PROPIMAGES.md. 2026-11-17: `linux_images` carries the MATLAB Linux image (object `imgc`, role `linux_image`): every row in the discovery lane, no per-family list (it has run on no die), scheduled outside the slot rotation (docs/design/V3_PROPIMAGE_LINUX.md section 14). 2026-11-17 (later): the MATLAB entry carries `min_guest_driver` (590.48.01, measured on one RTX 3080: MATLAB R2026b refused guest driver 580.159.04), and `matlabPlan` raises a die's default guest driver to it when the default is older (traces/matlab_gpu_20261117/). 2026-11-18: the MATLAB entry carries `bin` (the guest path of the matlab binary, MEASURED by an inspection boot: not on the guest's PATH) and `matlabPlan` copies it into the instruction's `matlab.bin`.

linux_images.label: matlab
linux_images.scheduling: one run per release box that has a KVM host and a GPU; not part of the A/B slot rotation
linux_images.min_guest_driver_basis: MEASURED on one RTX 3080 (GA102), one run, 2026-11-17 (traces/matlab_gpu_20261117/README.md): the same sealed image with guest driver 590.48.01 (CUDA 13.1) passed gpuDevice, the matmul and FFT rows and the Deep Learning Toolbox rows; with guest driver 580.159.04 (CUDA 13.0) gpuDevice failed with 'GPU computing in MATLAB requires a newer graphics driver'. MATLAB R2026b bundles CUDA runtime 13.1.80 (MEASURED). INFERRED, not separately proven: MATLAB refuses a driver older than its CUDA runtime. 590.48.01 is the lowest version tried that passed; no version between 580.159.04 and 590.48.01 was tried, and no other die was tried.
linux_images.bin_basis: MEASURED 2026-11-18 by an inspection boot of the image on a Vast box: the name `matlab` is not on the guest's ssh PATH (every row of the first strict run ended CRASH NO_USABLE_RESULT rc=127 at second 0); the binary was found by `find` at this path, under the image user's home (MATLAB R2026b, user kfimage). A property of this image: a rebuilt image may keep it elsewhere, so the path is configuration, never code.
